data.rationale: The proposal follows the true procedure in the right order (city, Special Events, event, ticket count, Book Now/time option, reserve), but it omits the date parameter and adds an extra "confirm" step after Reserve Now, and it makes event_name and ticket tier parameters that the true workflow doesn't have.
